subject: Usage safeguard & onramp — hosted API renewal and MAP
messages:
From: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@avaretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@avaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + throughput uplift questions

Marissa,

Quick note as we start our renewal planning for Q4 — usage for the hosted API has grown ~3.2x year-over-year and our product team wants to lock in a higher monthly commit and a clearer burst/overage guardrails window. A few asks:

- Can Redwood provide a proposal that shows (a) a monthly commit at 3x our current baseline, (b) a separate burst pocket for seasonal spikes, and (c) hard rate-limit behavior when we hit soft throttle vs full throttle?
- We need an SLO note — specifically what latency we can expect at 95th percentile with the proposed commit.
- Procurement: we prefer net-45 payment terms and need a PO lead time of 2 weeks before the new term starts.

Could we schedule a short technical + commercial sync this week? I can loop in legal if needed. I attached our recent usage export for context.

Thanks,
Sophia Nguyen
Director, Product Integrations
Ava Retail
[attachment: ava-usage-export-202508.csv (CSV)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@avaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + throughput uplift questions

Sophia — thanks for the data, this is exactly the right time to align.

High-level proposal (quick bullets):
- Commit: tiered 3x baseline monthly commit with a staged rollout (month 1 at 1.5x, month 2 at 2.5x, month 3 full 3x) to avoid sudden QoS disruption.
- Burst pocket: separate burst credit pool that triggers before overage billing; unused burst credits expire monthly.
- Rate-limits & throttling: soft throttle starts at 85% of sustained commit (short-term spikes allowed); hard throttle at 120% sustained beyond a 10-minute window. We can tailor the windows.
- Pricing: blended per-token rate for committed volume; overages billed at a reduced premium if consumed from burst pocket.
- SLO: our expectation at 95p with the proposed committed capacity is ~220–300ms p95 for common generation workloads (single-turn chat, 2k context). We’ll validate in the technical sync.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tech sync with Karthik (infrastructure) and Ben (account ops) — 45 minutes to confirm latency SLOs, model pinning, and canary plan.
2) We’ll circulate a draft quote (pdf) and a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and DocuSign link.
3) Procurement and legal can review terms; we’ll try to accommodate net-45 and document exceptions.

I attached a draft quote for your review. When are you available for the sync? I can do Thu 9/4 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 9/5 14:00–15:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Renewals
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-draft-quote-AVA-20250903.pdf (PDF)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@avaretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + throughput uplift questions — technical notes

Hi Sophia — quick technical notes ahead of the sync.

Thanks for the export — useful callouts. A few things we want to confirm on the call:
- Workload shape: are your peaks short bursts from promotions (seconds/minutes) or sustained increases (hours)? The commit + burst behavior differs.
- Model pinning: if you want deterministic latency we recommend pinning to a verified model variant and a quantization profile. That reduces variance across time.
- Canary test: we suggest a 7–10 day canary at 1.5x with sampling at 10% of production traffic routed to the new commit pool; we'll instrument latency and error rates and do an automated rollback if p95 degrades > 25% vs baseline.
- Autoscale knobs: we can set a short-term burst buffer (30 mins) and an extended buffer (6 hours) — both configurable.

Operational ask for Ava: please confirm the top 3 SLA-critical API routes and the 95th-percentile latency goal you want (e.g., 250ms p95). I’ll bring telemetry for similar accounts to the call.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Infrastructure — Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@avaretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@avaretail.com>, legal@avaretail.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + throughput uplift questions — PO timeline and terms

Marissa, Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple procurement/legal notes:

- PO & payment: we can initiate a PO that aligns with the proposed start date but need invoice net-45. Please confirm that DocuSign will reflect net-45 or indicate where that will be captured.
- Credits & overages: we prefer a rolling credit mechanism instead of monthly expiry for burst credits — any flexibility? If not, we need to understand the math clearly (how much effective protection the burst pool buys us).
- Security: our security team may request a short SOC 2 snapshot; can you provide the evidence link or a short attestation?

We’ll review the draft quote once you send the updated MAP and the DocuSign link. Attaching our procurement intake form — please populate the payment and tax fields.

Thanks,
Ava Procurement
[attachment: ava-procurement-intake-20250905.pdf (PDF)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@avaretail.com>, Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@avaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + throughput uplift questions — MAP and next steps

Team — appreciate the notes. Quick summary and commitments from Redwood:

- DocuSign & terms: we will generate a renewal amendment with net-45 payment terms and include a clause for PO lead time. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/AVA-Renewal-2025 (preview attached).
- Burst credits: we can offer an optional rolling-balance burst pool for Q4 as a one-time pilot (non-expiring for the quarter). If that works, we’ll model the effective coverage in the quote.
- SOC 2: forwarding the SOC 2 summary & attestation link in the MAP. (security team: see drive link in related_links).
- MAP: attached is a one-page mutual action plan with milestones: Tech sync (9/5), Canary start (9/15), Contract signed (9/22), Production lift (10/1). Please confirm the go/no-go date.

Action items:
- Sophia: confirm 9/5 14:00–14:45 PT for the tech sync (we’re holding the slot).
- Procurement: if net-45 is acceptable, we’ll update the DocuSign and send for signature tomorrow.
- Karthik/Ben: will prepare canary instrumentation and the sample telemetry deck.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-AVA-20250905.xlsx (MAP), preview-redwood-quote.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Renewals
Redwood Inference
[attachment: mutual-action-plan-AVA-20250905.xlsx (XLSX), preview-redwood-quote.pdf (PDF)]
